events.name: Goblin Ambush!
events.description: Arrows fly from the undergrowth! A band of goblins springs from the shadows!

events.name: Wandering Merchant
events.description: A cheerful halfling merchant rounds the bend with a mule laden with goods. 'Fine wares for fine adventurers!'

events.name: Mysterious Shrine
events.description: You discover an ancient shrine covered in moss. Strange runes glow faintly in the dappled light. Do you dare approach?

success.description: The shrine pulses with warm light. You feel the blessing of a forgotten god wash over you.

failure.description: The runes flare angrily. Dark energy lashes out!

success.description: You decipher the ancient text and discover a hidden compartment!

failure.description: The runes make no sense to you. You move on.

choices.description: Wisdom is knowing when not to touch ancient magic.

events.name: Hidden Cache
events.description: You notice a hollow tree stump partially concealed by ferns. Something glints inside.

success.description: Inside the stump you find a small cache of supplies left by a previous traveler.

failure.description: You reach inside but find only rotting leaves and disappointed spiders.

events.name: Hungry Wolf Pack
events.description: Low growls echo through the trees. A pack of wolves emerges, eyes gleaming with hunger.

success.description: You roar and wave your arms. The wolves whimper and scatter into the undergrowth.

failure.description: The wolves are not impressed. They attack!

events.name: Fairy Ring
events.description: A perfect circle of luminescent mushrooms pulses with arcane energy. The air shimmers and hums.

chain_event.name: The Fairy Court
chain_event.description: You materialize in a moonlit glade. Tiny winged figures dance around you. A fairy queen approaches.

choices.description: The fairy queen nods respectfully. 'Wise, perhaps. Or foolish.' You find yourself back where you started.

success.description: Quick as a shadow, you pocket a handful of glittering fairy dust!

failure.description: The fairies catch you! They curse you with bad luck and eject you from the glade.

events.name: Fallen Traveler
events.description: You find a wounded traveler slumped against a tree, clutching a bloodied map.

success.description: The traveler recovers and thanks you profusely. 'Take this — it leads to treasure.' They hand you the map.

failure.description: Despite your best efforts, the traveler has already passed. You close their eyes.

choices.description: A grim choice. You find some coins and a battered journal.

events.name: Spider Nest
events.description: Thick webs stretch between the trees. Movement stirs in the canopy above...
